note: Test keys only, made by protected40.py from fixed labels (stream(label, n): SHA-256 of the label and a 32-bit little-endian counter, concatenated). No SDK trusts them. The chains are signed by test roots that only these vectors use.
how: attest_body is what the SDK sends to POST /v1/attest: the install agreement key made in the Keystore with setAttestationChallenge(UTF-8 of `challenge`) and its chain, leaf first. A server under test pins `test_roots` instead of Google's, uses `status_list` as the attestation status list (a case with `status_list` false runs as if the list was never fetched), and holds `registered_digests` (null: nothing on record, the first install's digests become provisional; authoritative digests are an admin's, the key owner's or a PLAY_RECOGNIZED verdict's) for the app. The challenges are qlab-api's, made for the test token secret 'token-secret-not-real' and key 'apps-one', valid until 2100. ECDSA signatures are random, so `--check` verifies each case again instead of comparing bytes. `play_cases` and `order_cases` are deterministic.
